data.body_html:
Combine the thrill of reeling in Mediterranean fish with the romance of a sunset cruise on a Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2036. This 4-hour experience from Puerto Banús gives you two hours of guided fishing near Cabopino and Cala del Faro, followed by two hours of cruising past the Golden Mile with free-flow cava and snacks. Prices start at €749 for up to 11 guests — rod hire, bait, and catch prep included.

How the combo works

The trip runs 15:00–19:00, with the first two hours dedicated to fishing. The skipper motors out to known reefs and drop-offs where sea bass, bream, and mackerel are common. After you've had your fill, we turn west towards Marbella's coastline. The final two hours are pure relaxation: soft drinks, beer, cava, and light snacks as the sun sinks behind La Concha mountain. Timing adjusts seasonally so you always catch the best light.

Boats available for the combo

Two boats in our fleet are pre-configured for this combo at a flat €749:

  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests) — spacious flybridge for sunset views
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) — open cockpit ideal for rod work

Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and all taxes. For larger groups (up to 12), the Mangusta 80 is available — pricing on request via WhatsApp.

What you'll catch

The Mediterranean off Marbella is rich with species. Expect sea bass, gilthead bream, mackerel, and occasional bonito. The skipper knows the best spots near Cabopino and Cala del Faro, and will provide bait, rods, and reels. No fishing licence is needed — it's included in the charter. After the trip, the crew will clean and fillet your catch for you to take back to your accommodation or have cooked at a local restaurant.

Sunset cruising: the golden hour

From 17:00, we cruise east along the Marbella coastline. You'll pass the Golden Mile, Marbella Marina, and the Sierra Blanca foothills. The skipper will find a calm anchorage near Cala Cortés or Río Verde for the best photo opportunities. Onboard, the bar opens: cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and light snacks are all included. The boat has a sound system — feel free to connect your playlist.

Inclusions and extras

The price covers everything you need for a worry-free afternoon:

  • Licensed English- and Spanish-speaking skipper
  • Fuel and port fees
  • Fishing rods, reels, bait, and terminal tackle
  • Catch cleaning and filleting
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, cava, white wine, and light snacks
  • Insurance and Spanish IVA (21%)

You are welcome to bring your own food or drinks. The boat has a cooler and ice. Glass bottles are discouraged during the fishing leg for safety.

What to bring

Sun cream, sunglasses, a hat, and a light jacket for the evening breeze. Non-slip shoes are recommended for the fishing leg. If you plan to swim (conditions permitting), bring a towel and swimwear. The boat has a fresh-water shower on deck.

Booking and cancellation

Book via WhatsApp or our online form. We require a 50% deposit to confirm; the balance is due on the day. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. If the Port Authority closes the harbour due to weather, we reschedule or refund in full. The combo is available year-round, with sunset timing adjusted for the season.

Absolutely. The boat has safety equipment for all ages. Children under 12 must wear a life jacket on deck. The crew are experienced with families and make the fishing fun for kids.

Departure is at 15:00 year-round. The first two hours are dedicated to fishing. From 17:00–19:00, we cruise along the coast as the sun sets. In summer, sunset is around 21:30; in winter, around 18:00 — the itinerary adjusts accordingly.
